newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed - gasoline dips despite U.S.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed - gasoline dips despite U.S.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline fell $2 a tonne, despite support from the U.S. which has bought over 100,000 tonnes in recent days from Europe.
Rotterdam barges traded from $183.50 down to $180 before recovering late to talk $182.50 fob ARA for premium unleaded.
Naphtha defied crude's losses with swaps gaining up to $3 a tonne and physical holding steady.
Gas oil prices were slightly weaker but the underlying tone remained firm with tight ARA supplies firming barge and cargo premiums to counter losses on IPE gas oil.
High sulphur fuel oil barges ended on the upside at $86.25 and $86.50 fob ARA, breaking through the last few days' top trading range, on reported good demand and tight supplies.

High sulphur cargoes were also assessed steady with swaps gaining over a day earlier while one percent was also stable in the $92.50/$93.50 region after trades at the lower number in the past two days.
